# Using the policy templates

These English working templates are starting text for a specific client site, not a finding that any particular deployment complies with EU or national law. Copy them into the independent client repository only after filling all markers, deleting inapplicable activities, verifying the deployed site and providers, translating into the site's approved language(s), and obtaining the client's approval. Keep private provider contracts and evidence outside a public repository. The site needs accessible links to the final policies; a policy document does not itself implement consent controls.

The [privacy policy](privacy-policy.md) follows the information categories in GDPR Articles 12–14. Its contact-form description is grounded in this starter's current `src/components/ContactForm.astro` and `worker/contact.ts`; the final client's deployment may differ. The [cookie policy](cookie-policy.md) follows the EU device-access rule and Danish regulator guidance on necessity, prior consent for optional technologies, item-level information and withdrawal. Verify the relevant national implementation for the client's jurisdiction.

Primary references checked 28 September 2026:

- [GDPR, especially Articles 12–14](https://eur-lex.europa.eu/eli/reg/2016/679/oj)
- [ePrivacy Directive, Article 5(3)](https://eur-lex.europa.eu/eli/dir/2002/58/oj)
- [EDPB transparency guidelines](https://www.edpb.europa.eu/documents/guideline/article-29-working-party-guidelines-on-transparency-under-regulation-2016679_en)
- [Danish Data Protection Authority and Digitalisation Agency cookie guidance](https://www.datatilsynet.dk/regler-og-vejledning/cookies-og-lignende-teknologier/gode-raad-ved-brug-af-cookies-og-lignende-teknologier)
- [Danish Data Protection Authority's cookie and GDPR overview](https://www.datatilsynet.dk/regler-og-vejledning/gdpr-univers-for-smaa-virksomheder/cookies-og-gdpr)
